No. A court will likely not enforce the bar against assigning the right to payment, because this is a sale of goods and UCC § 2-210(2) allows assignment of a right to damages or payment for the seller's due performance despite a contrary clause. UCC § 9-406(d) also overrides terms that prohibit assigning a right to payment, so the center must pay the assignee once the distributor performs. This conflicts with the team note, and I think the note is wrong: neither of its "yes" options matches the UCC rule, so I'm keeping my answer.

CONFIDENCE: 85
